This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include these codes as defined in urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.6.238 version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server)
    CodeDisplay
    2028-9Asian
    2054-5Black, African or African American
    2135-2Hispanic or Latino/a/e
    2118-8Middle Eastern or North African
    1002-5Native American, Alaska Native, or Indigenous
    2076-8Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander
    2106-3White
  • Include these codes as defined in http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-NullFlavor version 📍4.0.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    ASKUI don't knowInformation was sought but not found (e.g., patient was asked but didn't know)
  • Include these codes as defined in http://ahip.org/demographics/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-additional-nullFlavor version 📦0.1.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    CNTRI choose not to respond at this timeThis code is to represent explicitly that the patient has chosen not to respond to this question at this time.

description: Used as the answer options for the initial race/ethnicity question in the Race & Ethnicity Section; the selection made here drives which granular background value set is conditionally shown next.
